# NANOPDF

> > NANOPDF is a document sharing and PDF hosting platform offering free downloads across academic, technical, and educational content.

NANOPDF Inc. operates as a non-profit file hosting service that enables users to upload, share, and download PDF documents across diverse categories including academic papers, technical documentation, and educational materials.

## Key Topics

- PDF document sharing
- Free file hosting
- Academic papers and theses
- Electrical engineering documents
- Astronomy and scientific research
- Educational content
- Non-profit document platform
- Category-based browsing
- Document downloads
- User-contributed content

## Platform Overview

- [Categories](https://nanopdf.com/categories): Browse document categories on NANOPDF platform
